evidence: The body initializes a small output and queries attribute_context_status_value_get with selector 0x14; it returns zero unless that status equals 4. On the passing path, it transforms a local byte, reads a 16-bit value from the global context record at +0x32, and calls two helpers before also returning zero. The helper and record meaning are not established by available callers, so this function remains unnamed (decompiled/main/main_0058.c:16385-16433).

Reads a 16-bit entry bound at input+0xd46a and returns false when the value exceeds 0x12b. For in-range values it returns true when attribute_context_status_value_get reports a nonzero value for selector 0x24 or 0x26; otherwise it calls f_7000780454 on input + index*0xa8 + 0x488 and negates that result (decompiled/main/main_0083.c:16906-16950). No indexed callers or semantic record evidence were available.

The routine requires attribute_context_status_value_get(selector 0) to return 8. It then checks a helper-produced context pointer; if present, selector 0x13 must also return nonzero. The final result is true only when the low byte of the value returned by f_7001826310 is below 2; otherwise it is false (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:35610-35656). The context object and byte meaning are unresolved. Caller f_7000ab294c returns this result masked to one bit, while a caller in main_0086 branches on the result (decompiled/main/main_0076.c:16992-17000; decompiled/main/main_0086.c:38055-38066).

Returns 0xfffffffe unless the byte at input+0x42a is nonzero and successive attribute_context_status_value_get(selector 0x13) calls return 6 then 7. On that path, maps the second argument to itself when it is 0, 1, or 2, to 3 when it is greater than 2, and to 0xfffffffe when it is negative (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:37666-37712). Indexed callers store the result into a record field (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:7806-7810, 8194-8198; decompiled/main/main_0112.c:26666-26670, 27437-27441).

After context and predicate checks, reads 16-bit values at the resolved record+0x98 and candidate+0x360. If they match, it calls the established ranked_player_attribute_entries_rebuild helper; otherwise it returns without rebuilding (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:6006-6051). Callers include process_attribute_record_candidate_values (decompiled/main/main_0056.c:5922-5926) and a separate record update path (decompiled/main/main_0054.c:50158-50162).
